newsitem.title: UK: INSIGHT - Bunds to aim for trendline up near 102.37.
newsitem.headline: INSIGHT - Bunds to aim for trendline up near 102.37.

text.p: June Bund futures have escaped an old range and are set for fresh gains up towards 102.37 trendline resistance on Friday, analysts said.
The contract on LIFFE at 0654 GMT was at 102.05, up 34 basis points from the prior close.
"We're still positive," said a trader at a German bank in Frankfurt. "We're breaking out of the recent trading range seen over the last couple of days."
He said the first target was around 102.18, a high on March 11, and after that around 102.37, where there is an ascending trendline drawn off lows in early April.
The trader said the trendline was rising eight ticks a day and would be at 102.45 by Monday. "This should be the top," he said.
On the downside, lows on the DTB at 101.92 on Friday were likely to provide support, he said.
The trader also said the market was seeing curve steepening as other currencies weakened against the mark. As a result, five-years were outperforming Bunds, he said.
September Euromarks were at 96.74, up 0.01, having tested resistance at 96.75. Analysts advised putting stop-buys on any breaks above there.
